'''March 2001 Columbus tournament (24 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Silverking, Columbus, Ohio on 24 March 2001. [[Brian Sykes]] won it. It is known from Brian Sykes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1949">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-25-turning-the-corner-columbus-oh-3-24-01d1949/ turning-the-corner-columbus-oh-3-24-01], DeckTech (Brian "Armus" Sykes, 25 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-25-turning-the-corner-columbus-oh-3-24-01d1949/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Silverking, Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections II Booster Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Sykes]]
